hook: A tail rotor blade separated from an EC135 helicopter over Monmouthshire.

sections.voiceover: A tail rotor blade separated from an EC135 helicopter over Monmouthshire.
sections.visual_cue: Wide aerial tracking shot over rural Monmouthshire farmland, followed by an archival technical schematic of an EC135 tail rotor fenestron assembly.
sections.sfx_cue: Helicopter rotor thrum cutting into a sudden muffled metallic snap and quiet wind.
b_roll: EC135 helicopter in flight technical schematic
sections.animation_cue: Slow push-in on the tail rotor assembly in the schematic.

sections.voiceover: On 16 November 2025, helicopter G-WPDA landed safely in a field near Dingestow. Investigators examined the separated fenestron blade to trace its failure. What caused the blade on G-WPDA to fail?
sections.visual_cue: High-resolution map pinpointing Dingestow, Wales, transitioning to crash investigation photography of helicopter G-WPDA resting in a field.
sections.sfx_cue: Subtle radio chatter fading into low suspenseful drone.
b_roll: Map graphic of Monmouthshire and Dingestow
Air Accidents Investigation Branch field report imagery
sections.animation_cue: Map pin drops on Dingestow with subtle radar ripple.

sections.voiceover: But on 16 November 2026, the Air Accidents Investigation Branch found dye-penetrant on G-WPDA's fatigue crack.
sections.visual_cue: Extreme close-up macro photograph of metal fatigue striations on a rotor blade surface under laboratory ultraviolet lighting.
sections.sfx_cue: Deep bass drop with an electronic pulse sound.
b_roll: Laboratory macro footage of metal fatigue crack
sections.animation_cue: Ultraviolet light sweep revealing crack highlight line.

sections.voiceover: The Federal Aviation Administration superseded Airworthiness Directive 2024-04-10 for affected aircraft. Regulators mandated repetitive inspections for Airbus Helicopters Deutschland GmbH EC135P1 models.
sections.visual_cue: Official Federal Register documentation graphic scrolling over Airworthiness Directive 2024-04-10 text, followed by animation of fenestron blade inspection procedures.
sections.sfx_cue: Keyboard click sound followed by camera shutter snap.
b_roll: EC135 tail rotor maintenance inspection footage
sections.animation_cue: Text highlight effect over Airworthiness Directive reference number.

sections.voiceover: Repetitive inspections now safeguard EC135P1 tail rotor blades.
sections.visual_cue: Cinematic medium shot of an EC135 helicopter tail rotor spinning up safely on a helipad.
sections.sfx_cue: Rotor blade whistle fading to silence.
b_roll: EC135 helicopter tail rotor operating on helipad
sections.animation_cue: Slow zoom out to full aircraft outline.
